stories.title: Ministers must be honest about Russian threat to UK, says former Foreign Office head
stories.summary: Former national security adviser Peter Ricketts urged UK ministers to speak plainly about what he called an immediate Russian threat. He warned that hybrid attacks could cost lives and called for stronger resilience across banking, energy and water systems against cyber-assaults. Ricketts previously advised David Cameron as prime minister.

links.headline: Ministers must be honest about Russian threat to UK, says former Foreign Office head
links.excerpt: Peter Ricketts calls for more resilience in protecting banking, energy and water systems from cyber-assaults Ministers need to be honest with the British public about the immediate threat posed by Russia, which could soon lead to lives being lost, a former national security adviser has said. Peter Ricketts, who advised David Cameron when he was prime minister, became the latest figure to warn about the scale of the threat posed by “hybrid attacks” from Vladimir Putin’s forces.

stories.title: Cocaine-Funded Gangs Shake Colombia Years After Peace Pact
stories.summary: Cocaine-funded militias are carrying out attacks against civilians in Colombia eight years after a peace accord removed a major rebel group from the field. The linked report attributes the continuing instability to state inaction after the agreement. It describes the gangs as powerful and the violence as a sign of the peace pact’s unfinished aftermath.

links.headline: Cocaine-Funded Gangs Shake Colombia Years After Peace Pact
links.excerpt: Attacks by powerful militias against civilians reflect the state’s inaction eight years after a peace accord removed a powerful rebel group from the field.

stories.title: Canada Is Becoming a Fentanyl Exporter, and a Target for Trump
stories.summary: Fentanyl is increasingly being manufactured in and trafficked from Canada, drawing scrutiny from President Trump. The linked report says the quantities remain small compared with flows from Mexico. Even so, Canada is being described as an emerging exporter rather than only a transit or destination country.

links.headline: Canada Is Becoming a Fentanyl Exporter, and a Target for Trump
links.excerpt: The drug is increasingly manufactured in and trafficked from the U.S.’s northern neighbor, though the numbers remain small compared with Mexico.
